text:
noemi_sales: Heads-up — VegaPay wants a compact POC next Thurs. Must show low-latency streaming (WS preferred), function/tool-calls for transaction extraction, strict JSON schema outputs, SAML SSO + customer KMS, and a simple monthly delta reserved vs hosted for procurement. Can eng pull together runnable samples in ~48h?

kai_eng: We can. Node WS + lightweight Python SSE fallback + a replay driver to simulate steady ~900-1k QPS. Minimal WS demo handshake: 
```js
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-2');
ws.on('open', () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({input:'parse_tx', stream:true})));
ws.on('message', m => console.log('msg', m));
```
I will stage the replay in a sandbox.

juan_se: For structured output: function-calls with explicit JSON Schema and a live validator. Example expected tool result (stringified in demo): {"tool":"extract_tx","args":{"payer":"string","amount":{"type":"number","currency":"USD"}}}. Show a 422-style structured error on mismatch: {"error":{"code":"SCHEMA_MISMATCH","path":"/args/amount","received":"string"}}.

kai_eng: Ops tradeoffs: for stable 1k QPS use reserved pool; batching window 10-25ms balances cost/latency. We should demo prefix caching too. Fallback policy: overflow -> lower-capacity variant with header `x-redwood-fallback: true`. Auth: SAML for console, ephemeral API tokens (STS) for SDKs TTL 15m-1h. KMS support: AWS/GCP/Azure CMKs + HSM.

pat_ops: I'll provision a reserved demo cluster and attach their AWS CMK once we have key ARN. Deployer bot will post the sandbox endpoint when ready. Need the replay script by EOD to run perf.

maria_legal: Please send the security questionnaire to me. Upload link for VegaPay: https://onetrust.example.com/vega-upload. They'll want SOC2, KMS key policy, residency, and contract SSO clauses. I'll prep NDA and the standard security packet.

noemi_sales: Procurement wants a ballpark monthly delta for reserved (steady) vs hosted (autoscale + batching). Keep it simple for initial procurement.

kai_eng: Quick ballpark (very rough): reserved small pool (4x A100 eq) for 1k QPS text gen ~ "$29k/mo"; hosted autoscale with batching and caching ~ "$18k/mo". I'll produce a token-based calc tomorrow.

juan_se: Demo tip: show client-side schema validator highlighting field errors, then show automatic corrective prompt flow. Also show a structured fallback payload: {"result":null,"errors":[{"code":"MISSING_FIELD","field":"amount"}]} so integrators can map to UX behavior.

deployer_bot: sandbox created: sandbox-vega-01. Endpoint: https://sandbox.redwood.ai/vega (KMS pending).

pat_ops: Timeline: collect Vega sample prompts today, perf replay tomorrow AM, live demo Thu 10am PT. I'll loop in infra if we hit capacity.

noemi_sales: Great. I'll ask VegaPay for sample prompts and security contact now. @maria_legal I'll send NDA. :thumbsup:

kai_eng: Small routing + batching snippet we'll demo (YAML):
```yaml
route_policy:
  - match: high_qps
    capacity: reserved:vega-01
    fallback: redwood-lite
batching:
  max_delay_ms: 20
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  prefix_cache: true
```

noemi_sales: Thanks all — ping me if anything blocks. I'll update the Vega deck with these points and the cost slide.
